hero.tagline: Parallel development for the agent era.
hero.subtitle: One Mac-native window. Many worktrees. Every agent.

features.heading: What is TouchCode?
features.intro: TouchCode is a terminal development environment built for parallel development with coding agents. It orchestrates all of your projects, worktrees, and coding agents into a single window.

items.title: Native
items.body: Built on Ghostty and native to macOS — every Ghostty and macOS capability comes for free.

items.title: Agent-first
items.body: See the live running state of every agent in real time.

items.title: Parallel
items.body: Project tree + git worktrees + tabs + split panes let you manage every line of work in one window. No more Cmd-Tab.

items.title: Custom commands
items.body: Bind project-specific commands and shortcuts; one chord runs the right thing.

items.title: GitHub
items.body: Deep GitHub integration — manage the whole pull-request lifecycle in-app.

items.title: Git Viewer
items.body: A built-in diff and history panel. Review changes any time, without leaving the terminal.

items.title: Keyboard-driven
items.body: A deep set of customizable shortcuts to keep you fast.

items.title: IDE integration
items.body: VS Code, Cursor, Zed, and Xcode are auto-detected. One shortcut opens any worktree.

cta.title: Get TouchCode.
cta.sub: Drag into /Applications. The tc shim installs itself on first launch.
